scope: reload acceptance trial with a bound controller's restart episode across the handovers; release binaries built from the reload integration branch (uncommitted merge, tree recorded); private daemon under a disposable home

source.note: the merge of fence-bindings, main and the reload stack tip, with the store's deferred data migrations and the trial's controller scenario; committed as the next commit on the branch

scenarios: 384 messages sent through 20 reloads arrived once, in order; 0 send errors
133 agents launched (half stopped early) during the reloads all finished; 0 launch errors
both loggers' logs are contiguous across every reload
batch and PTY fixtures exit with exact codes under the last daemon with complete logs
a lease and a pending question kept their identity and expiry across every switch; the question was answered after the last
a bound controller's restart episode ran to exhaustion across the handovers: 5 launches, attempts [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 19 handovers accepted in between
limits: The launch descriptor is /bin/sh, outside any managed installation, so the controller's installation pin is not exercised here; it is unit-tested (pin_controllers under the fence) and needs an installed trial.
The launched controller ends on its own after two seconds; a controller that starts and never binds (bind grace, SIGTERM, SIGKILL) is unit-tested, not trialled here.
Replay retention limits and Windows are not covered; provider-side acceptance (live Claude/Codex conversations across a switch) is codex's.
